{{Quote|I'm just amazed at the turn-out and am touched by the strong desire to help the refugee movement. I know the cynical have no shortage of critical things to say about the wealthy, but the money we raised tonight, I think, shows that these people do care and are generous.|[[Kaysil Verwood]]|<ref name="HNN Fundraiser" />}}
The '''Refugee Relief Movement fundraiser''' was a fundraising reception for the benefit of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]]&mdash;or RRM&mdash;that was organized on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The event was held in the newly-built [[Xenvaer]] [[Xenvaer Civic Auditorium|Civic Auditorium]] during the fourth [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and was attended by many important [[Politics/Legends|politicians]],<ref name="HNN Twang" /> including the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], his functionaries, [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] and [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], the members of his [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]],<ref name="HNN Fundraiser" /> and his predecessor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="HNN Twang" /> The journalist [[Dyslogia Twang]] was also present at the reception in search of gossip for her column "[[Sightings by Twang]]."<ref name="HNN Twang" /> Despite preliminary criticism from the morning com-host [[Brookish Boon/Legends|Brookish Boon]], the fundraiser was successful, having raised an estimated 75 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the Refugee Relief Movement.<ref name="HNN Fundraiser" />
